prompt:
Create a single pixel-art eye atlas from the attached NPC080 sad reference grid. Use the attached image as the exact local visual reference. Return a 2-column by 2-row atlas with overall aspect ratio 64:35 (approximately 1.83:1); each of the four equal cells must have the same 64:35 aspect ratio as one reference panel. No borders, gutters, labels, text, or extra panels.

Cell order, row-major:
Top-left: sad expression, both eyes looking left, fully open.
Top-right: same sad expression, both eyes looking right, fully open.
Bottom-left: same leftward gaze, natural half blink.
Bottom-right: same rightward gaze, natural half blink.

Keep the face identity, eye spacing, original 64x35 framing, original muted pixel-art palette, and stationary sad brow shape from the reference. Change only the eye and lid pixels. Keep irises compact, irregularly stepped olive-gold, close to the original iris width. Use a small dark pupil and one tiny subdued warm glint per eye. Both eyes must look in the same requested direction, with visible and anatomically coherent pupils. Keep pupils inside the eyelid opening. Half-blink lids should lower naturally and consistently while leaving a small recognizable part of each same-gaze iris visible. Preserve warm brown skin and eyelid shading, subtle contrast, and crisp native pixel edges.

Do not enlarge or round the irises, turn them into broad disks or bars, move or reshape the brows, change the sad expression, add bright white sclera flashes, sharpen, smooth, blur, antialias, or add colors absent from the muted source palette. Keep hair, forehead, skin outside the eye features, background, face crop, and all pixels outside the eyes unchanged. Do not add closed-eye cells; closed phase reuses the existing same-emotion closed source.
